nodes.label: ADR 0016: Card-on-File via SetupIntent + Off-Session Charges
nodes.rationale: Card-on-file via standard Stripe pattern: (1) get-or-create Stripe Customer on tenant's Connect acct with metadata; (2) save card via SetupIntent usage=off_session, web mounts Elements+PaymentElement, confirms; (3) list saved cards from snapshot acct; (4) charge saved card off-session using customer's snapshot acct (not country resolver). SCA requires_action surfaces as toast in v1 — manual follow-up. Stripe Customer per tenant scope (tenant owns customer relationship).
alternatives_rejected: Stripe Subscriptions for memberships (pricing patterns not Stripe-friendly in v1)
Customer on platform acct (violates merchant-of-record boundary, Stripe classification problem)
